body.script: const done = arguments[arguments.length - 1];window.__TAURI_INTERNALS__.invoke('greet', { name: 'wd-async' }).then((value) => done(value), (err) => done('ERR: ' + err));

const button = document.createElement('button');button.id = 'wd-probe-button'; button.textContent = 'click me';button.onclick = (event) => { window.__wd_click = event.isTrusted ? 'trusted' : 'untrusted'; };document.body.appendChild(button); return 'installed';
